label: Movement
tooltip: Mounting, sprinting, and unsticking for all travel (Illegal Mode, Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt, Mob Farmer).

should_auto_mount.label: Mount while traveling
should_auto_mount.tooltip:
On: mount for long travel and remount if you dismount mid-route (Illegal Mode, Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt, Mob Farmer).
Off: stay on foot unless something else mounts you.

should_jump_when_stuck.label: Jump when stuck
should_jump_when_stuck.tooltip: When movement stalls on rocks, ledges, or stairs.
